job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in modern frontend frameworks (Angular and/or React) and Python-based backend development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications, collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications.
Build responsive and user-friendly interfaces using Angular and/or React.
Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices using Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architecture discussions.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across the technology stack.
Collaborate with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
Ensure application performance, security, and reliability.
Core Competencies
4-8 years of experience in full-stack software development.
Strong proficiency in Angular and/or React.
Strong backend development experience with Python.
Experience building RESTful APIs and web services.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Familiarity with Git and modern version control workflows.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Required Qualifications
Frontend
Angular (v12+) and/or React
TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
Html5, CSS3, SCSS
State management (Redux, NgRx, Context API)
Responsive and cross-browser development
Backend
Python
FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks
REST API development
Authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth)
Database
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server
MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
Cloud DevOps
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Docker and containerization
CI/CD pipelines
Kubernetes (preferred)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with microservices architecture.
Exposure to event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience with automated testing frameworks and test-driven development.
Knowledge of security best practices and application monitoring.
Experience working with AI/ML-integrated applications is a plus.
Success Metrics
Deliver high-quality features on schedule.
Maintain high code quality and test coverage.
Improve application performance and reliability.
Contribute to technical design and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate effectively across engineering and business teams
